Raised2026-10-06 (America/Los_Angeles). Source-only milestone2 support for the worldwide coverage-gap goal and joint Portugal–Spain investigation #972. Engineering now has an exact full-source prototype; remaining observations include five native centres matching both official countries' member polygons and one matching neither. This worker investigates source authority/precision/physical-water records rather than changing geometry or assigning owners. Do not duplicate existing regional interior #242/#243 workloads or overwrite research packets.

Bounded six-centre scope (lon/lat unchanged from canonical candidate preview):
- both: cell126077/99248 (-6.873431337396909,40.002191593667014), DGT0505 and IGN1173184.
- both: cell126068/99272 (-6.885789919364072,39.97694180898698), same members.
- both: cell126053/99322 (-6.906387555975982,39.92430811747299), same members.
- both: cell125754/99583 (-7.31696711244021,39.64890317423009), DGT0502 and IGN1173135.
- both: cell125752/99584 (-7.31971346398845,39.64784586349555), same members.
- neither: cell125663/99573 (-7.441926107885848,39.659475392270686), no matched official member.

Retained full component gap:ad2052defbeba8e89287bcc4344e641225c6579f9afd584497b381fe8fd8eedc, seven current contact subjects and Spanish55-member crosswalk remain unchanged. Original twelve full official polygons are preserved at1ba7ef86a046db62c2c19d731faf8118e6cee124 in research/geography/shared-seam-prt-esp-20261006/. GEO7 already verified full current service roster closure, so do not repeat that collection without new evidence. GEO6 physical-water #1163/PR1167 retained whole AOI river/reservoir planning records; reuse those immutable originals and explicit limits, rather than assuming planning polygons prove current wetness. Candidate405 and full21,575-centre observations are previews, not installation or legal authority.

At most2 source-only PRs in research/geography/prt-esp-six-cell-authority-20261006/:
1. Retain authoritative dated source documentation and complete necessary originals/metadata for the exact six-centre ambiguity. Inspect official administrative geometry precision/measurement/date/datum/border conventions and, where applicable, official bilateral boundary records and independent physical water observations. Use documented public read-only APIs/files, default TLS and lawful bounded original-byte retention. Prefer official direct evidence; no browser, paid provider access, scraping unsupported terms or imagined accuracy. Capture exact source records/URLs/licenses/retrieval timestamps/count/page closure and identify whether evidence applies to the point, full local segment or a wider AOI. No point-query result alone proves a political affiliation.
2. If required, produce a bounded reproducible appraisal and next-record handoff, retaining every unresolved authority/date/datum/registration/wetness/precision question and every failed request. Complete the source assessment with supported versus unknown conclusions; do not force a classification or claim a repair. Give engineering exact source IDs, semantics and uncertainty for future #972 integration. No full regional replacement or automatic nearest-member reassignment.

Approval/acceptance: whole-file lawfully retained source bytes/hashes and explicit limitations; each of the six points has an individual source assessment/coverage and exact missing evidence if unresolved; official authority and physical-water observations stay distinct; immutable producer before final two runs when deriving outputs; meaningful controls for mistaken planning-versus-wetness, stale dates, omitted source members, mismatched IDs/context and unavailable providers; distinct exact-head source/method review, normal CI/queue, actual merge/readback and safe claim/slot release. Existing32MiB decoded/file,256MiB reader and512-descriptor limits remain unchanged. Preserve original sources, failed candidates, unknowns and geographic history. A documentation-only conclusion may legitimately remain unknown, but cannot close #972 or the worldwide goal.

Only the new owned research directory may be changed. Never change core/native geography, application code, other packets, production facts/providers/databases, deploy, ask publisher chat or use the user's browser. Work on GPT6Luna/Medium with an own persistent unbudgeted goal for this bounded source assessment. Claim under own actual identity, one active claim/author slot, fresh branch after each actual merge; maximum2PR. Root orchestrates engineering and integration separately.
